# Bounded evidence output for this authorized legacy CI

This supplements communication and clarifies current admitted phase scope. Preserve frozen roles, five injected blocks, original planner steps, gate semantics and readonly source scope. Scope comes from the actual injected phase and admitted plans: the knowledge fallback’s skeleton/c-bemu “no RTL claim” describes those earlier rounds; an admitted slices/rtl round now requires real RTL terminal evidence.

- Load actual knowledge once and record exact paths. Consume each injected block and generated plan once; do not repeatedly echo context.json, the full source tree, full logs or the complete plan. Keep the full report with the required five-block values and every declared coverage result.
- For tool results, print only actual success/failure/processing/returncode/trace_id, binary/chip identity and a short diagnostic; preserve complete raw evidence using the host audit and artifact paths/hashes. An archive path is evidence only when the host actually wrote it. Read bounded excerpts needed to diagnose a real failure.
- The extension explicitly records topPlans (unchanged chip stage/phase), backendPlans (chip backend coverage generated by the unchanged ball/rtl planner), and childPlans. Execute top BEMU then the complete child c-bemu prerequisite before any Verilator operation. All required steps must have actual same-run terminal evidence at the frozen checkout SHA.
- Existing exact endpoint/arguments/trace terminal evidence may satisfy overlapping plan identities without repeating unchanged builds/simulations when each original plan's order still matches. Record a separate phase table referring to the same real trace. Never reuse prior-source, prewarm, queued or accepted evidence. If order requires another step, execute it and record why; do not reorder or edit the plan.
- For slices, eight existing top stems represent all eight Balls; the child includes additional Clamp capacity/composition/MLIR checks. Only actual overlap may reuse a trace. Capacity positive runs only through BEMU. RTL uses explicit rtlStems and runtime negatives with exact implemented assertions.
- Expected failures remain separate from positive stems. Report each declared backend/case, real terminal failure and trusted exact diagnostic match. Missing runtime/tool/dependency evidence is INFRA. A missing or mismatched content diagnostic is FAIL. Zero real tests can never produce functional PASS.
- Keep report.md complete and final-answer verdict consistent; the CLI stores final text separately. Preserve original raw negative/compiler logs in session evidence. No dispatch/push/credit/API-provider change is authorized here.

For legacy_clamp_v1 integrate with slices-gate found=false, the phaseProtocol block is mechanically enforced. Follow its original-planner childPrerequisite and selfRunPlans: complete all five c-bemu positives before any RTL, finish both eight-stem slices sequences, then integrate. The adapter rejects out-of-order native submissions and records the actual same-service slices-prerequisite-complete boundary. Integrate simulations require submissions after that boundary; earlier slices simulations cannot substitute. Shared successful build traces can be reused only in original plan order. No prior-run trace or manufactured history satisfies this protocol.
